backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260513-012 policy semantics.

before_variant.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

best_variant.target_definition: official Space customer_win source profile and peer momentum leader

decision_rationale: The source-qualified peer-leader scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must stay shared and metadata-only with live Space slots at zero.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe. Source and peer-state fields are production-visible, but any accepted Space change must remain default-off until forward evidence matures.

accepted_multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

peer_momentum_state.source: accepted Space basket momentum enrichment from exp-20260511-115 stack

runtime_fields: space_peer_momentum_state from accepted Space signal enrichment

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: scale only official customer_win Space signals that are also peer momentum leaders.

2_history_check.exp-20260512-009: Rejected generic peer-momentum leader risk. This run is not generic; it requires a production-visible customer-source catalyst profile.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-038: Accepted broad official customer-source scalar earlier in the Space stack; this run does not retune that scalar.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-944: Rejected primary-authority source split. This run does not split source authority and adds peer leadership as the only new discriminator.
2_history_check.exp-20260513-002: Rejected customer-win pool hard pruning. This run keeps the candidate pool fixed and only tests risk allocation.
2_history_check.exp-20260513-012: Accepted multi-event catalyst-depth 1.075x risk helper; this is the fixed before state.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_customer_source_peer_leader_risk_scalar. Candidate pool, accepted Space stack, targets, stops, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL versus exp-012 accepted stack, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 total trades, nonzero adjusted signals, and non-1.0 scalar.

hypothesis: The strongest near-term Space alpha should combine production-visible catalyst quality with in-basket relative strength. Generic peer-leader risk was too broad, while source-only retunes were unstable; this narrow scalar tests whether official customer-win signals deserve extra risk only when the ticker is already leading its Space peers.
interpretation: The source-qualified peer-leader scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must stay shared and metadata-only with live Space slots at zero.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space soft-ranking remains label-limited; this run uses deterministic production-visible event source and peer-momentum metadata.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not promote source-qualified peer-leader risk scaling on these frozen snapshots. Future Space alpha should either wait for closed forward replacement value by source/peer bucket or test another production-visible catalyst-quality field with broader coverage.

single_causal_variable: risk scalar for official Space customer_win source signals whose own 20d momentum is above the official Space basket average
